get.description:
Method retrieves a transfer event logs.

`offset` - parameter of integer type that indicates pagination offset.

`limit` - parameter of integer type that indicates pagination limit.

`history_id` - parameter of UUID type that specifies relevant history record (either history_id or transfer_id should be provided).

`transfer_id` - parameter of UUID type that specifies relevant transfer record (either transfer_id or history_id should be provided).

`event_type` - parameter of int type that indicates event type. Allowed values are:
```
100: "ObjectTransferred"
200: "SkipObject"
300: "NoSpaceLeft"
301: "PermissionDenied"
302: "AccessDenied"
303: "NotADirectory"
304: "ConnectorError"
305: "EmptySource"
306: "LimitReached"
400: "Other"
```

`event_category` - parameter of int type that indicates event category. Allowed values are:
```
1: "Success"
2: "Error"
3: "Info"
```

`as_enum_resolved` - parameter of bool type that indicates whether to resolve event_type and event_category as strings.

Example: `/v2/events/list?offset=0&limit=1000&history_id=3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6&as_enum_resolved=false`

base_image.title: Base Image
base_image.description:
The base image where the model training script will be run. This image must be from `cr.ai.cloud.ru/aicloud-base-images` or from the project of the Docker registry for the current workspace. If the image does not exist, the job will not be created and the corresponding error will be returned.

See [List of base images for training jobs](https://cloud.ru/docs/aicloud/mlspace/concepts/environments__basic-images-list__jobs.html).

instance_type.title: Instance Type
instance_type.description:
Configuration of computing resources. The value is specific to the region. Examples: `v100.1gpu`, `a100.1gpu`, `a100.8gpu`, `a100.1gpu.40`, `cpu.2C.8G`.

To get a complete list of available values, use the [/configs](#tag/configs/operation/get_config_public_v2_configs_get) method.

region.description: A group of resources available for use in different modules of the platform. See [Regions documentation](https://cloud.ru/docs/aicloud/mlspace/concepts/references__regions.html).

type.description: Type of job. It can be a machine learning framework or a binary executable file (binary).

n_workers.title: N Workers
n_workers.description: The number of working nodes in the region where the script will be run.

processes_per_worker.title: Processes Per Worker
processes_per_worker.description: The number of job processes that need to be run on a single computing node of provided resources. If not defined, the value is equal to the number of GPUs requested for one computing node.

internet.title: Internet
internet.description: If `true`, internet access will be allowed from the script.

conda_env.title: Conda Env
conda_env.description:
Allows you to specify the name of the conda environment if the image contains such an environment and uses anaconda rather than the standard python environment.

See [Creating an environment with the required Python and CUDA version using the CLI](https://cloud.ru/docs/aicloud/mlspace/concepts/guides/guides__cli/environments__cli-env-create.html).

max_retry.title: Max Retry
max_retry.description:
The maximum number of attempts to restart the job before it is completed. The parameter is only used for volcano jobs and by type `[horovod, torchrun, pytorch2, pytorch, binary]`.

Valid values are from `integer [ 3 .. 100 ]`.

priority_class.description: Allows you to organize the execution of jobs in order of their importance.

queue_name.title: Queue Name
queue_name.description: Name of the queue in which the job will be scheduled and executed. This parameter determines the execution priority and resource allocation for the job according to the queue's policy and configuration. If not specified, the default queue is used.

allocation_name.title: Allocation Name
allocation_name.description: Name of the allocation in which the job will be scheduled and executed. If not specified, the default allocation is used.

checkpoint_dir.title: Checkpoint Dir
checkpoint_dir.description: The folder for saving checkpoints. Should be located in `/home/jovyan`.

logs_dir.title: Logs Dir
logs_dir.description: The folder for saving job logs. Should be located in `/home/jovyan`.

health_params.description: Configuration parameters for monitoring stucked jobs.

shm_size_class.description:
Shared memory size.

 small = 16GB * n_gpus, medium = 32GB * n_gpus, large = 64GB * n_gpus

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Flags that will be passed to your script: `script.py (--flag1=<flag1> ... train script args...)`. Values can be transmitted with spaces, paying attention to quotes.

env_variables.title: Env Variables
env_variables.description: Environment variables that will be available inside the script. Values can be transmitted with spaces, paying attention to quotes.

pytorch_use_env.title: Pytorch Use Env
pytorch_use_env.description: Allows you to use the `--use_env` flag for `torch.distributed.launch`. Only works for job type `pytorch2`.

elastic_min_workers.title: Elastic Min Workers
elastic_min_workers.description: Sets the minimum number of workers for Pytorch Elastic Learning jobs. Only works for job type `pytorch_elastic`.

elastic_max_workers.title: Elastic Max Workers
elastic_max_workers.description: Sets the maximum number of workers for Pytorch Elastic Learning jobs. Only works for job type `pytorch_elastic`.

elastic_max_restarts.title: Elastic Max Restarts
elastic_max_restarts.description: Sets the maximum number of restarts for Pytorch Elastic Learning jobs. Only works for job type `pytorch_elastic`.

forbid_s3.title: Forbid S3
forbid_s3.description: If `true`, there will be no access to S3 from the script.

forbid_internet.title: Forbid Internet
forbid_internet.description: If `true`, there will be no access to internet from the script.

stop_timer.title: Stop Timer
stop_timer.description: This parameter specifies the time (in minutes) until forcibly removing the job, with `Running` status.

in_communal_cluster.title: In Communal Cluster
in_communal_cluster.description: Allows users in the allocation to run jobs outside of it. If `true`, the job will run outside of the allocation.

include_nodes.title: Include Nodes
include_nodes.description: Nodes that should be included from running job.

exclude_nodes.title: Exclude Nodes
exclude_nodes.description: Nodes that should be excluded from running job.
